activity_statements.statement: operates approximately 36,000 retail coffeehouse locations globally (company-owned and licensed) serving espresso beverages, teas, Refreshers, food, and packaged goods to consumers
employs approximately 400,000 global associates (baristas and coffeehouse leaders) to staff company-operated stores
operates five US manufacturing and distribution centers that produce and distribute beverages and food products to retail locations
sources, roasts, and blends coffee beans through a global supply chain working directly with coffee-growing farmers in countries including Ethiopia, Colombia, and Costa Rica
operates the Starbucks Rewards loyalty program and mobile ordering app enabling digital ordering and reward accumulation for frequent customers
operates Reserve Roastery premium coffeehouse locations in select US cities (NYC, Chicago) offering elevated coffee experiences and curated menus

name_reality_gap: none — the name is an honest description of a coffeehouse chain. The index label 'Restaurants & Food Service' is accurate, though the digital loyalty/mobile ordering platform is an underappreciated technology asset.
extraction_notes: Investor annual reports page returned 404. Stories page timed out. About and careers pages provided good coverage. Store count of 36,000 is from widely reported public data; careers page confirms 400,000 employees and five US manufacturing/distribution centers.
